messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: rstan and gcc6
parts:
Hi!

Did anyone have some luck in getting rstan up and running with a g++ 6.3.0_1 from macports?

Rstan installs from source OK, but when I try to run any model, for example the eight_schools model, it just barfs at me like this:

stan_demo("eight_schools")
Loading required package: StanHeaders
rstan (Version 2.14.1, packaged: 2016-12-28 14:55:41 UTC, GitRev: 5fa1e80eb817)
For execution on a local, multicore CPU with excess RAM we recommend calling
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
> 
> J <- 8

> y <- c(28,  8, -3,  7, -1,  1, 18, 12)

> sigma <- c(15, 10, 16, 11,  9, 11, 10, 18)

> tau <- 25

 *** caught segfault ***
address 0x20, cause 'memory not mapped'

Traceback:
 1: .Call(Module__classes_info, xp)
 2: Module(module, mustStart = TRUE)
 3: .getModulePointer(x)
 4: <S4 object of class "Module">$stan_fit4model14b993c4a0fc9_eight_schools
 5: <S4 object of class "Module">$stan_fit4model14b993c4a0fc9_eight_schools
 6: eval(expr, envir, enclos)
 7: eval(call("$", mod, paste("stan_fit4", model_cppname, sep = "")))
 8: object@mk_cppmodule(object)
 9: .local(object, ...)
10: (function (object, ...) {    standardGeneric("sampling")})(object = <S4 object of class "stanmodel">, data = <environment>)
11: (function (object, ...) {    standardGeneric("sampling")})(object = <S4 object of class "stanmodel">, data = <environment>)
12: do.call(sampling, args = dots)
13: stan_demo("eight_schools")

Possible actions:
1: abort (with core dump, if enabled)
2: normal R exit
3: exit R without saving workspace
4: exit R saving workspace
Selection: 2


I am on macOS sierra, latest R and my desperate Makevars look like:

CC=gcc-mp-6
CXX=g++-mp-6

#CXXFLAGS=-O3 -mtune=native -march=native -Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unused-function

CXXFLAGS=-O0 -Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unused-function

CXXFLAGS+=-fPIC -g

## for gcc 6 only
##CXXFLAGS+=-flto -ffat-lto-objects  -Wno-unused-local-typedefs
CXXFLAGS+=-Wno-ignored-attributes -Wno-deprecated-declarations

I have no clue what is going on... and I hope someone has seen (and solved) this already.

Thanks.

Sebastian

PS: Things work with clang, but I want g++6 which I can already use with cmdstan on the same models.

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: Re: rstan and gcc6
parts:
Hi!

To answer my own question for reference to others: You have to install Rcpp from source when you want to use gcc6 on Mac!

I am not sure if this is on the wiki, but we (or I) will check for that.

Best,
Sebastian
